name: jshoes-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins: productivity hooks, dev workflow skills, and execution discipline tools

plugins.name: alt-text
plugins.description: Guidance for writing effective image alt-text grounded in accessibility standards and screen reader user research. Provides a classification framework, image-type specific rules, identity description decision tree, and quality checklist.

plugins.name: essentials
plugins.description: Essential hooks for Claude Code: safety guards, attribution reminders, GPG assistance, heredoc prevention, and event logging

plugins.name: plugin-support
plugins.description: Miscellaneous skills and documentation for Claude Code development: hook authoring guide and hook reference

plugins.name: alfred-workflow
plugins.description: Skill for programmatically creating and managing Alfred 5 workflows from the command line

plugins.name: delegation-guard
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that encourages main-session delegation to subagents via escalating reminders.

plugins.name: stop-advisory
plugins.description: Stop hook that provides configurable advisory guidance before session stops, with an ack-token handshake for deliberate confirmation.

plugins.name: haiku-enforce
plugins.description: PreToolUse hook that enforces Haiku model for all subagent launches via updatedInput.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development workflow skills and agents for GitHub-based repos. Includes /session (full dev lifecycle), /triage (issue prioritization), /solve (issue-to-PR with conditional routing), /code-review (multi-agent PR review), /research (systematic context-building), /spec (lightweight specs for design decisions), /consult (structured decisions), /reflect (session retrospective), /issue (file well-researched issues), and the worktree-implementor agent (isolated worktree execution). Concern-oriented design with conditional skill routing.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Opinionated frontend design skill anchored on dark-mode, information-dense, content-focused interfaces. Replaces the generic CC built-in frontend-design with concrete design tokens and component patterns derived from curated reference sites (Bluesky, GitHub, Gmail, LessWrong, Claude.ai).
